en.t: Well now... what type would this belong to?

units.source_text: 眼下我属于南泉，你属于赵州，

en.t: For the moment, I belong to Nansen, and you belong to Joshu,

units.source_text: 或许有朝一日，你成为南泉，而我却成为赵州也未可知。

en.t: but someday you may become Nansen, while I may become Joshu, for all we know.

units.source_text: 因为这桩公案正像猫眼是多变的啊！"

en.t: Because this koan changes just like a cat's eye!"
